notes.title: Crossplay Update & 31st Anniversary Sale!
notes.content:
Patch Notes: 1.7.3B
================
Added Crossplay under Settings
Removed invite requirement for Private Lobbies
Made lobbies discoverable during character selection (instead of Level 1)
Updated intro splash screen with $uprDee artwork

[u][b]What is Crossplay?[/b][/u]
Crossplay allows you to play the game online with other players that are playing on the Epic Games Store version of ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove!

[u][b]How do I enable Crossplay?[/b][/u]
From the Main Menu go to Settings -> Online Settings -> Epic Crossplay, and change it to "On". Then link your Epic Game Store account. 

[u][b]I don't have an Epic account, can I still use the Crossplay?[/b][/u]
An Epic Games Store account is required to use the Crossplay feature. 

[u][b]Can I set up a private lobby for only my friends to join?[/b][/u]
Yes! When selecting an Online game, choose "Friends Only" to make a private lobby. Your friend can filter the online lobby list to easily see your lobby.

[u][b]My friend and I are both on Steam, why can't we see the online Lobby?[/b][/u]
Make sure you both have the Crossplay setting On or Off. If one player has Crossplay enabled, but the other doesn't, you won't be able to matchmake. 

[u][b]Changing the Setting doesn't seem to be working?[/b][/u]
If you have changed the setting recently please restart the game for the changes to take effect.

[u][b]Will Crossplay work with the console versions of the game?[/b][/u]
There are no plans to incorporate crossplay on the console versions at this time.

sup y'all!?

Today we are releasing a quick update to Back in the Groove containing some fixes that we addressed while working on the Switch build.

Thanks to everyone who reported the Endless World save games not loading, this patch should fix that issue. If your save continues to infinitely load then please start a new game and be sure to follow up if the issue persists after that.

One change we'd like to address is the intended distribution rules from the Still in the Groove Update.
Part of the Still in the Groove Update was intended to reduce the number of Earthlings and bushes/trees on all levels, especially in the early game. This change never made it's way through and is now fully working as intended.

What you should notice is much less Earthlings in the early game which will ramp up more as the levels progress. By around Levels 10-15 it should feel similar to the amount of Earthlings prepatch but the numbers have been reduced across ALL levels while still maintaining the difficulty of the late game.

Let us know what y'all think. In the meantime we will be focusing on the Switch update.

notes.title: STILL in the Groove Update NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]sup y'all? [/h1]
Been a minute. I think we missed a couple of holidays, a New Year and maybe a baby shower. Sorry about that. But we are [strike]BACK[/strike] STILL IN THE GROOVE, yo!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26087041/f4cc10252e76e0fb9b5b2ccaaa55e35a21918daf.png[/img]

Last year we opened the 1.7.0 Update Beta to collect feedback. [b]It's been tough[/b] but we are finally ready to show off what we've been working so long on. The Earl sized change we made this time is the new [b]BIGGER[/b] Fixed World maps. These maps were [i]handcrafted by the OG funklord[/i] Greg Johnson. 

While playtesting the maps Greg kept coming up with new ideas and tweaks to make the gameplay more fun! 

So first, we heard the feedback about Earthlings being too frustrating and adjusted their behavior to make them a lil more funky to deal with. If you enjoyed the previous Earthling difficulty make sure to check out the [b]Extreme World[/b] where the Earthlings are much harder. 

Players also didn't like when Power Hats were instantly granted after stepping off an Elevator. [u][b]Power Hats are now hidden on the map in bushes that sparkle![/b][/u] When you shake a sparkling bush the Power Hat will fly around for a bit before landing. Players can find up to 2 Power Hats per level. So make the most of them while you have them!

Present Stacking synergies are a feature we introduced in 1.6.0 where using certain presents together will make some funky new effects. 
There are 3 hidden present synergies that will cause something cool or funny to happen. 
[i]Can you find the secret present combinations that unlock them?[/i]
We will give you a clue: the presents need to be AMPED.

So just to recap:
[h1]NEW BIGGER Fixed World Maps![/h1]
[h2]Find the Hidden Power Hats![/h2]
[h3]Smarter and less frustrating Earthlings![/h3]
[h3]Funky Secret Present Synergies?![/h3]

[b]Full Patch Notes[/b]
[u]1.7.1 [Still in the Groove Update][/u]

[[u]Map Changes[/u]]
All new Fixed World with much larger maps
Removed the smaller maps that would appear on Level 8 and Level 19 in Fixed/Random/Endless Worlds (these smaller maps still appear in Extreme as a 'pit stop' to farm up)

[[u]Earthling Changes[/u]]
Reduced Earthling density by ~50% across all levels in Fixed/Random Worlds
Reduced Bush/Tree density by ~40% across all levels in Fixed/Random Worlds
Reduced Earthling speed and notice range
Earthlings now have a random chance of dropping aggro if a player is under water
Increase chance of Earthlings dropping aggro if the player gets too far
Earthlings will now chase you to the edge of the map and edges of water/ice 
Earthlings can now walk down revealed secret paths
Mailbox Monsters will stay off secret paths
Man In Black will no longer chase if you have no presents
Fix Ghandi not providing his safety if another Ghandi was nearby
Various fixes for Earthling pathfinding in Networked games

[[u]Power Hat Changes[/u]]
Power Hats will no longer be automatically gifted to players when stepping off the Elevator
Power Hats must be found on the level by searching bushes and trees
Power Hats sparkle while hiding
Power Hats will fly around like flying presents when found, they will land after a short time
Power Hats now provide 100XP when picked up
Power Hat weights adjusted to make some hats more rare and some more common
Removed hitbox offset while wearing Hat of Sure Walking

[[u]Balance[/u]]
Ship Pieces now reward correct XP when picked up
Remove level cap on presents in all modes. (This means you can find ALL presents from the beginning of the game)
Button/Coin Meter chains are maximum 4 presses
Speed up animation when pressing button/feeding coin meter
Removed forcing the player into position when feeding Coin Meters/pressing Buttons
Removed forcing the player into position when speaking to a friendly Earthling
Adjustments to camera while falling down levels
Present timer now pauses when falling
All inputs disabled while falling (prevents players opening presents and teleporting)
Added XP Notification to bottom left of HUD
Adjusted XP Bar Colors to hopefully be more noticeable to new players
Removed multiplayer only presents from showing in single player games

[[u]Fixes[/u]]
Many under the hood improvements to memory usage
Speed up Elevator streaming to next level
Fix movies not playing on Linux version
Fix No Ship Piece on Level 25 in rare cases
Fix issue where players could go beyond Level 25 when an Endless save was active
Fix everything bunched up on Funkotron in Endless
Fix Lamont showing up on Level 28 of Endless
Fix Sushi not always providing heal
Fix Torch breaking present timer
Fix PlayerStates (like Cupid effect) breaking present timer
Fix 'Jump To' invulnerability exploit
Fix Elf spawning infinitely from a bush
Fix FPS Cap not remembering every time you load the game

Also a [b]SUPER[/b] huge shoutout to our homey $uprDee for making the promo artwork for this update! If you haven't checked out his ToeJam & Earl comics make sure you're following him to see more funky fun!

notes.title: v1.5 Console Updates and PRICE DROP!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26087041/fe4b4cea4774e2bc6b5cb7d057b2616e1edd5216.png[/img]
Sup y’all?! We’re back! Some would say, BACK IN THE GROOVE!! Did we use that joke already? It’s hard to keep up! We hope you’ve all been keeping funky while we’ve been working on rolling out these console updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26087041/970c199854618ba1b9edfdfefd1e8f51a4a1f71e.png[/img]
CONSOLE UPDATES? Where are they? You said September! ...we did, and we apologize for not hitting that deadline. Extreme World was pretty easy to polish up and get ready as it’s just some simple number and balance changes, but keeping the console versions from not crashing during Endless World was more of a challenge for our small team than we expected. We are developing simultaneously for multiple platforms with a team of less than 5 people now, and your patience is much appreciated. But the good news is, they are absolutely ready now and they should all be rolling out this week!!!

As always you can get caught up on the changes for Extreme and Endless Worlds in our previous update here: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1578116861/toejam-and-earl-back-in-the-groove/posts/2553797. We highly recommend reading this if you plan on completing Extreme World, which contains over 100 fan requested balance changes. Some information that has changed in this post are the issues listed in the beginning, they have been ironed out already and we have changed Endless World from unlocking by reaching Extreme World Level 15 to unlocking at Level 10 based on player feedback. If you’re still having a hard time unlocking Endless try playing with a friend or hopping online to meet some new homies!  

Greg has said that if anyone can beat Extreme and Endless Worlds and provide proof he will gladly sign your copies of the game. So if you’d like to attempt that madness feel free to email us at support@humanaturestudios.com with your proof and we will hook you up with some signed copies of our Limited Run Games PlayStation 4 or Nintendo Switch physical releases!

Other than these new modes coming here is a list of small changes and fixes we have added in the meantime between 1.4 and 1.5.

New Extreme Mode
New Endless Mode
Fixed softlock that occurs when picking up a telephone while rolling a hat
Players loading into the game will be temporarily immune to damage for a few seconds
Fixed present menu breaking enemy aggro
Prevent searching for 2 seconds after immediately opening a present (prevents accidentally searching)
Fixed NPCs not Amping/Fixing present when they reward you
Fix broken effect on presents overlapping player models
Fix Latin American Spanish button in language screen
Always freeze presents when in elevator
Join network game has public tab first
Swap Bodies swaps difficulty as well
Fix searched presents getting stuck in midair when inventory is full
Make telephones trigger smaller
Make telephones add grace if triggered from elevator
Fix Earthlings popping back up in the air Wile Coyote style before falling off a level
Fix Earthlings getting stuck on hills
Network: Fix elves being shaken out and disappearing on clients
Remove Hula Girl and UFO from the Good Earthling present
Fix telephones from presents making no sound
Fix invisibility paint not working against Troll and Tourist
Fix Santa dropping Sushi
Backer credits fixes
In-Game Manual fixes
In-Game text fixes

These changes will bring the console versions more in line with the Steam version now. We are considering adding the ability to see the level below to console versions as an option for players who prefer to see it over having optimal performance. What’s that? MORE UPDATES? Yup, we are hoping to keep this train going as long as we can. The game is doing well enough that we can continue at the pace we’re currently chugging along at. But the better the game does the longer we can continue to support it. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26087041/e5c80e5dad6c99b3b21362c442e808800826cb8d.png[/img]

Which brings us to our next big announcement, we are dropping the price from $19.99 to $14.99! Obviously this is less exciting for all our loyal fans who already have the game. We wanted to bring the price down because we noticed a lot more sales around this price point during out previous sales. If you haven’t been able to find homies to jam out with online nows the time to hop back in with a friend and get funky!

Speaking of funky, check out our new trailer here: [previewyoutube=cC-vm8VqQX8;full][/previewyoutube]

PLUSHIES AND MERCH

Where are those plushies, when are they coming?! The answer is very soon. We have approved the final designs for them and The Yetee hopes to have them available by the end of the year. We love how they look so far and we hope you love them as much as we do! Speaking of our Funkotron Shop, we are nearing the very end of our inventory and we will be closing it very soon. Stock is extremely low on the remaining items. It turns out getting 1,000 levels to work on consoles wasn’t as easy as it sounded... but we are very close to having these ready for release! The Switch edition needs one more round of testing before we can officially move into cert, and then PS4 and Xbox versions will follow shortly. notes.title: July Update with Extreme and Endless Worlds!
notes.content:
Hey all! Time for the FUNKY JULY UPDATE with some bug fixes and Extreme and Endless Worlds!! And the good news? It’s launching tonight on Steam! Extreme Mode is ready to go but Endless comes with a few issues we would like to bring to your attention before we get started with this update:

-[i]Infinite loading Elevators causing a softlock[/i]. Must restart game to fix.
-[i]Closing the game will remove your entire inventory[/i]. This can be prevented by dropping your inventory on the ground before you save and close.
-[i]If you get stuck in an Elevator that won't go up and won't let you out of it while playing online, you may have to kick the players in your game and have them rejoin, or Save & Quit and restart.[/i]

Since the Steam version is much easier to patch than the console versions we will be pushing 1.5.0 out onto Steam first with a warning that Endless is still in beta. Once we get all these bugs sorted out we will then push a new update out with all the fixes to Steam and consoles in the form of 1.5.1. Console players, thanks for being patient with us as we get this sorted out!

So for those of you that haven’t heard, we agreed to create two new modes just for our most hardcore dedicated players. The players that want more of a challenge that was introduced in the first game, while also keeping the pace and new mechanics introduced by Back in the Groove... THIS MODE IS FOR YOU!! We understand that some players already feel Hard Mode is Hard enough so instead of making changes to that mode all these new changes will be applied to Extreme Mode with only a few making it into Endless and only the ‘quality of life’ changes getting brought into Fixed/Normal/Hard. 

First off, how Extreme World and Endless World are unlocked. Extreme World is unlocked by completing Hard World, if you have already completed Hard World you may have to complete it again for Extreme to unlock, and Endless is a reward for players who are able to get to Level 15 in Extreme Mode.

Endless World starts exactly like any Random World, but at Level 50 all your presents get un-identified and some Extreme World changes will start to be applied. [b]Every 50 levels after that your presents will continue to be un-identified, so be careful![/b] Endless World has infinite Promotions as well, so your character can go beyond Funklord! This means in Extreme World the enemies are OP but in Endless World YOU’RE going to be OP!

When you get to the character select screen in Extreme you may notice the characters have been rebalanced a bit for this mode, here are a couple of the buffs and nerfs they have received:

All characters have been given a special focus on what makes them unique. We have also increased a bunch of their stats to hopefully help you max out one or two during your Extreme playthough. Players felt that even though they are achieving Funklord rank, that none of their skills would ever get maxed out. Because of this we have introduced the auto search feature that occurs at Max Search rank to begin around Rank 6 Search Skill instead of only applying on Max. This means that when you search there is a very small chance that items will automatically pop out of their surroundings. This chance increases the more your Search Skill increases.

Earl & Old Skool Earl have had their speed, health and inventory size increased. Both Earls have been given reduced Damage to Broken Presents (trust us, you’re gonna need it in this mode!) Regular Earl has been given an increase in Search Skill specifically, while Old Skool Earl is now buffed in Present Skill. Flo gets similar buffs to both Earls but with a focus on support. We have kept Flo’s passive increased Hi-Five health (especially with Earl!!) but also given her increased heal on Good Food. Earl gets a small health increase when he picks up bad food and Old Skool Earl still gets his 2 for 1 Sushi, but we have increased the health of Sushi in this mode. So essentially Old Skool Earl is given a tiny pocket heal he can carry, while Earl gets his extra healing from bad food on the floor, YUCK! 

We have increased GeekJam’s speed to be on par with his cousin ToeJam while also making him a great scout character as he gets a larger detect radius when he searches and he also has a chance to Identify a present on pick up. Of course he retains his random stat boost when opening a School Book present. 

Latisha and Lewanda are now really skilled with presents, Latisha having a higher present skill and much more deadly tomatoes and Lewanda having more Luck and extra ability to Fix a present on pickup. Latisha is now very good at clearing out a level for safe searching, while Lewanda retains her free coin meters (coin meters have also been given a bit of a buff).

Peabo has been given buffs to his stats but also retains his slow movement speed making him more of a ‘Hard Mode’ character. Due to his small size though we have given him a new passive, he is less likely to be noticed by Earthlings! So although Peabo is small and slow there is more of a chance of you sneaking around an Earthling to secure those extra presents and bucks lying on the ground. 

And now for some disappointing news… we have decided to hit ToeJam with some nerfs in this mode. We know, we know, we love our homeboy TJ too, but he has been the dominant choice in the game since the first one. So we have decided to reduce his movement speed by one, keeping the ‘Jam family (Old Skool form and his cousin GeekJam) the fastest characters in the game. In order to do this we had to reduce Latisha’s movement speed by 1 making her more in line with all the other characters while keeping TJ’s family the fastest. We also removed the double time to both ToeJams on their mobility presents (Hitops, Rocket Skates and Spring Shoes) as we felt this provided too much of an advantage to just blast through levels. 

Instead ToeJam is given a chance to Amp a present on pick up (based on Present Skill) and Old Skool ToeJam is given increased speed with Hitops. ToeJam is still the most viable character in the early game, which is really useful for gathering presents before the game starts to get tough, but most other characters only need to roll 1 speed upgrade to catch up to him.

notes.title: Peabo/Lamont Surprises, Slingshot/Tomato controls, 1.4.0 Content Update AND A LOT MORE!!!!
notes.content:
Greetings

Hello to our favorite Earthlings!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26087041/881d19e5967ad48ee0d08d1f3075433275530f89.gif[/img]

We’ve been working hard over here at ToeJam & Earl HQ to continue supporting Back in the Groove. As you all continue to play and give us feedback, we are continuing to improve the game, fix nasty bugs, fine-tune presents, and balance Earthlings and the overall difficulty of the game. We are here to talk about a few of those exciting changes making their way into version 1.4.0 of the game. 

We’ve already released a larger patch for all platforms (v1.2.3), but we have plans to release more very soon!  The next patch 1.3.1, out today on PC, will support the Peabo and Lamont Surprises, for all you backers who pledged at a tier or higher that included these in-game items. We’ve begun rolling out BackerKit emails that include redeemable Steam codes for the Peabo Surprise and the Lamont Surprise! Make sure to keep an eye out for those. If you are expecting these codes and do not receive them about a week after we post this update feel free to contact us: support@humanaturestudios.com 


Peabo/Lamont Surprise DLC

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26087041/10c0f178651ac5f54feb461290cef902a7063ecb.gif[/img]

Now what do these surprises consist of exactly? Well, in case you missed it in our previous update here’s a short run through:

Peabo’s Surprise is the ability to dance on command. You activate this by using the Quick Chat menu and selecting ‘Dance’. When this happens all the trees and bushes around you will dance as well (similar to what happens when you open a Boom Box). When you do this the music track will also change. We can’t wait to see y’all bust some funky moves online. 

And now for the Funkopotamus himself - Lamont’s Surprise! This is a super cool Lamont costume headpiece that all the Funkotronians can wear! While wearing the Lamont head you will also get some special dialogue that unlocks while wearing it. This functions similarly to ‘Earthling Disguise’ where you can still wear your Power Hats under it.


We are aware that some of these may be sought after by those of you who didn’t back to unlock them. We are considering giving these rewards away to contest winners and outstanding/active members of the community. Stay tuned for more info on that!

Currently the Peabo/Lamont DLC only works for the Steam version of the game. We are looking into making the DLC work for consoles at a later update but unsure if we can make this happen. For now this is how you redeem the codes on Steam: 

Please make sure ‘ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove!’ is fully closed and do not launch the game until the download is finished.
 
1. Launch the Steam client software and log into your Steam account.
2. Click the Games Menu.
3. Choose Activate a Product on Steam on the bottom left of the window.
4. Follow the onscreen instructions to complete the process.

Up to Speed with 1.3.0

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26087041/22b316c03c4ddcdc434634f196c6cb6ace99792b.gif[/img]

So with that out of the way let’s talk version 1.4.0. The consoles that do not currently have 1.3.0 will have all the fixes and improvements introduced in those versions which include:

Fixes for Difficulty not being chosen when starting a new game, no more double Elevators spawning on top of each other, speeding up Santa’s dialogue a bit, fixes the Level 0 Mini Map glitch, Ghost’s should be revived when reaching Funkotron and no longer haunting the game from ending, sound going missing on the Secret Level, Spanish (European) language options, volume adjustments for some of the louder sound effects, and a bunch of other small tweaks.

Slingshot/Tomato Present NEW Aim Control

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26087041/264732482dc9c61a441a640d2cbc675d43baefad.gif[/img]


You may have noticed that we have yet to roll out the new Slingshot and Tomato controls. We are sorry this is taking longer than usual but due to the changes we made we had to redo all the animations for each character family, this delayed them a bit but we are very excited to get these into your hands. Currently the new controls for the Tomato Present make the throwing function similar to Game 1 where your character stays rooted in place while firing. The Slingshot Present functions more as a ‘run-and-gun’ similar to what we currently have but with a reduction on movement speed while firing so you don’t bump into the Earthling you’re trying to pop. Both presents now retain the direction you’re facing while firing, no more snapping to face the screen when you let go of the directional input. Also, both presents allow you to hold A to stay rooted while you pick a direction and fire away!

1.4.0 Content Update

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26087041/a53bd2e356d20ded367a449749249f2c58b4cd43.gif[/img]

So now for the moment you’ve all been waiting for: version 1.4.0. Well what exactly is it? OUT WITH IT!! Fine, we will tell you, stop poking us with that stick. Version 1.4.0 is shaping up to be the definitive Back in the Groove experience, especially for console players. With this update we will be introducing 3-4 player local play on all versions of the game. They said it couldn’t be done, but just like getting split screen to work with the original ToeJam & Earl, we were determined to make it happen. 

In order to get this to work we unfortunately had to limit the amount of distance between players if they fall a level. The game will now only allow players to fall 3 levels apart from other players in multiplayer. If you jump off that third level you will be transported back to the start of it, meaning players who would rather jump than take a hit still have that option. And if you guys find a present that will help you get to Level 0 you can both jump down together to visit the secret area. 

1.4.0 Balance Updates

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26087041/d765ca83b8dfdadab5ad368b281bc160d04695fe.gif[/img]

1.4.0 also comes with a ton of balance changes. We’ve been hearing that a lot of our veteran players find the game too easy if they use all the new mechanics to their intended effect. There are a ton of changes coming and most of these are in mind of making the game a little more difficult without making it too difficult for our casual players.

First up is Present changes. We are changing all Amped ‘Show X’ presents to be ‘Jump To’ presents instead of staying in your inventory. This means that instead of Amped ‘Show Wiseman’ giving you two uses, the Amped version will ‘jump you’ directly to the Wiseman. This applies to ‘Show Elevator’ as well and we have changed ‘Jump To Ship Piece’ to ‘Show Ship Piece’ with the Amped version being the current ‘Jump To Ship Piece’ present. Amped ‘Show Hidden Paths’ will reveal the Hidden Paths and reward you with an XP Boost based on our Present Skill stat. We are making these changes because players would keep the ‘Show X’ presents in their inventory the entire run hoping it would become Amped-This-Level so they could use it throughout their run infinitely. These changes will hopefully make the presents more unique and balance out the unintended behaviors they were providing.

We are also reducing the time you have ‘Icarus Wings’ for by 10 seconds in regular and Amped versions and a slight move speed decrease only on the Amped. We have been hearing from players that this present makes it too easy to clear multiple levels without touching the ground. The regular version of ‘Icarus Wings’ is now intended to get you out of sticky situations and clear gaps if you get stranded on an island. The Amped version is now intended to be the present you use if you want to clear out a level or two.

Another change regarding ‘Icarus Wings’ is that Backer Islands will no longer always have free Icarus Wings on them, they will have a random mobility present such as Hi-Tops, Spring Shoes, Rocket Skates, Timed Teleport, etc. This change is to make it so players don’t just land on the island to collect the free wings then safely fly through the rest of the game. The present was only there in order to help get you off the island when you visit the Backer. But hopefully these new presents will help you out.

We know the Football Player has been the cause of numerous frustrating deaths. This Earthling will now do a reduced damage but knock you really far to make him more unique and less frustrating to deal with. 

These are just a few of the balance changes we have coming up and we have many more we are excited to share with you. We will be closely monitoring these changes and eager to hear any feedback you may have. 

PS4 Theme (Americas)

As some of you know, we’ve been trying to get PS4 themes for folks! We have now gotten them for the Americas and they should be popping in your email inbox in the same place you got your game PS4 codes.

Unfortunately, that being said, we were not able to create codes for the European version of the game. The folks at Playstation have been absolutely awesome in helping us get the codes for the Americas, however the system in Europe handles themes completely differently and making codes for them is not possible. If this is a Total Bummer for you please contact us at support@humanaturestudios.com and we will try to make it right. We never wanna leave folks hanging!

I never played Toejam & Earl in 1991. I didn’t own a Mega Drive, and my friends with one never had it. And, children, in 1991 we didn t have a The Internet in our houses back then, not even a bit. So I grew up in a world where it simply didn t exist. Playing this revival of the series – Toejam & Earl: Back In The Groove – almost incomprehensible in its strangeness, I m a bit sad that was the case.

There was a 1993 sequel, also on Mega Drive, and then almost a decade later, peculiarly, an Xbox only release in 2002. I didn t have an Xbox either. It s been a game of cat and mouse. I didn t even notice that Sega released both the first two games on Steam in 2012. But now, at last, we are united. Gosh, it s odd. It s definitely not very good.

notes.content:
90s-as-heck aliens ToeJam and Earl have returned in ToeJam & Earl: Back In The Groove, one of the more surprising fruits of the recent retro revival crowdfunding craze. The designer of ye olde original ToeJam & Earl from Sega Mega Drive in 1991, Greg Johnson, took this follow-up through Kickstarter in 2015 and now it launched this morning. TJ&E is… a roguelikelike actually inspired by Rogue, except it doesn’t have much fighting, and you collect loads of random items with weird effects, and it’s funny, and it’s silly, and it has hot jams, and it still can’t be easily compared to another game after 28 years, which speaks to how curious it is.

notes.title: ToeJam & Earl Gets a Funky New Sequel In 2017
notes.content:
ToeJam & Earl are back for another crack at some old school roguelikelike shenanigans and funky grooves. Aided by a Kickstarter in 2015 and now publishers Adult Swim Games, ToeJam & Earl: Back in the Groove [official site] is due on PC sometime in 2017. Back in the Groove will see the Sega Mega Drive cult classic’s stars crash land back on Earth, where they’ll have to do their best to fit in with the locals while they try to piece their ship back together.
